signature.name: Frame-Budget Footprint
signature.description: How much of the loader repaints per frame, how many layers it promotes, and whether it costs nothing when idle or hidden.

lesson: Strong loaders keep the moving part small, on its own layer, and driven by nothing but a pausable CSS clock; weak ones animate five things inside one SVG and call it lean because the keyframes only touch transform and opacity.

bare-wire.signature_why: Six shapes, fills only, zero JS in the path, will-change only on the two scars; but SVG-child animation still repaints the whole 120px each frame and there is no play-state hook.
bare-wire.loved: Heal disc and its second animated node deleted; one keyframe reused at a -2.5s offset, scale/opacity only, frame 5.0 equals frame 0.
bare-wire.docked: Still two pasted SVG copies and the whole SVG repaints; the hole at 120px is a dark disc on a near-black cup, so legibility rests on the held 0.5s beat.
bare-wire.fix_note: Held, larger scar taken and the heal rim removed with the heal; the markup-halving ask was declined on a plausible Safari shadow-tree reason, so no leaner.

warm-hands.signature_why: Rotation sits on an SVG child group inside a symbol/use, so the cup and everything else repaints each frame in both instances; will-change on sweep and bloom twice over, and v2 added one more animated stream.
warm-hands.loved: One 5s period on everything, linear sweep with zero-slope sway and opacity so the seam is genuinely closed; the stain keyframe was deleted rather than patched.
warm-hands.docked: Added a fourth animated element (stream shimmer) to a loader whose cost problem was already the full-SVG repaint, and the spiral still reads as a turning rosette.
warm-hands.fix_note: Layer split refused as a point of gain for a second SVG and a stacking bug surface; honest and README-disclosed, and the reason is defensible, but the repaint cost is unchanged.

the-glitch.signature_why: All keyframes are transform/opacity with no will-change anywhere, so no stray layers, but five-plus animated nodes (4 on a 1s beat) share one SVG and repaint it whole.
the-glitch.loved: Every hard cut in the drop is gone: fade in from scale .3, gravity fall, squash and fade into the ring, with opacity 0 whenever the transform resets.
the-glitch.docked: Markup still pasted twice, and the crema count reads as fill-then-drain at 4.6s despite the 80% cap, which the pitch admits.
the-glitch.fix_note: Drop snap/teleport replaced with eased fade and squash, and the slip that I asked to cut to 4px was deleted entirely, which is cleaner.
